newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Utilities help boost Abidjan bourse.
newsitem.headline: Utilities help boost Abidjan bourse.

text.p: Ivory Coast's electricity company CIE and water company SODECI helped the Abidjan Stock Exchange (BVA) achieve a seventh successive weekly rise, the Bourse's market report showed on Friday.
The All-Share Index rose 0.41 percent to 394.57 points, taking the 1997 rise to 10.28 percent.
The 12 VB blue-chip index did better rising 1.23 percent to 270.95 points, taking the rise for the year to 11.97 percent.
CIE (+1,540 CFA francs to 16,660 CFA) led risers which included maritime company SIVOM (+920 to 20,130) and SODECI (+790 TO 17,760).
Paint company SAEC-ASTRAL (-1,050 to 12,450) led fallers which included publishing company CEDA (-550 to 10,600).

Turnover in cash terms was down on the previous week with shares worth 155,536,000 CFA changing hands against 248,200,000 CFA. Fewer shares changed hands -- 8,320 shares compared to 9,174 the previous week.
Rubber firm SOGB accounted for over a third over shares traded -- 3,160. It closed unchanged.
